name: Jewelry organizer folding casket display mirror stand White
description:
Width: 11cm
Depth: 6.5cm
Height: 23cm
 Single panel dimensions: 9.5cm
6.5x11.5x23.5 cm—Folded; 1.5x46x23.5 cm—Unfolded
The box has 153 holes for 77 pairs studs & long earrings, 3 long U grooves for necklaces, bracelets or other jewelry. Keep all your earrings organized and at your fingertips.
In this box, there is a mirror for you to make up and wear accessories anytime and anywhere.
